bagPolicy.summary: The stadium A-Z guide allows clear bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches; all bags are inspected on entry. The cited guide addresses Ole Miss football, so confirm any concert-specific exception.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For football games, campus parking opens at 7am and all campus parking is reserved with an OMAF parking pass. ADA stalls require both a gameday parking pass and a state-issued ADA credential, and golf cart shuttles run from ADA stops around campus (Parking and Transportation: 662-915-7235). Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

rideshare.summary: The stadium guide designates the South Lot east of Old Taylor Road for rideshare pickup and drop-off on football game days; concert traffic plans may differ.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The stadium A-Z guide identifies concession areas for football games; concert menus and payment options depend on the event.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The guide identifies accessible parking and seating, accessible restrooms, and an elevator on the east side at Gates 13 and 14.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Under the published football policy, a person may leave and re-enter only with a valid unscanned ticket. A concert-specific re-entry rule is not stated.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For football games, the ticket office is at the Sandy and John Black Pavilion on All-American Drive, on the north side, and opens three hours before kickoff. Visiting team will call and the pass list are at Gate 19. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: For football games, stadium gates open 2 hours before kickoff, and your mobile ticket shows the gate you need. The ADA access elevator is at Gate 15. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
